name: nonApi_resetEmailStatus
description: Puts a hasher's email delivery status back to Unknown (EmailStatus 0) with a zero soft-bounce count and stamps EmailStatusChangedAt (E19.F4). Called when a hasher's email ADDRESS changes (the status described the old one) and when an admin clears a bounce after asking for a new address. Never touches updatedAt (the Hasher triggers do not fire for these columns), so nothing re-syncs. No-op when already Unknown with count 0. When a row changed and @reason is given, one LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'EmailStatus', StrParam1 = hasher id, Data = @reason) is written. Internal (EXEC from SPs / the API); no auth. @hasherId is required: NULL ⇒ THROW ⇒ caught ⇒ Success 0 envelope, logged.

parameters.name: hasherId
parameters.description: The hasher. Required (NULL ⇒ Success 0 'hasherId is required'). Default NULL.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Why — written to LOG.GeneralLog.Data when something changed. NULL ⇒ no log row. Default NULL.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: Always exactly one row: the standard { Success, ErrorMessage } envelope, from the TRY on success or the CATCH on failure.

columns.name: Success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 when the CATCH block ran.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block on failure.

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Hasher SET EmailStatus = 0, EmailSoftBounceCount = 0, EmailStatusChangedAt = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() WHERE id = @hasherId AND (EmailStatus <> 0 OR EmailSoftBounceCount <> 0). updatedAt untouched; no re-sync.
Inserts one LOG.GeneralLog row (LogSource 'EmailStatus') when a row changed and @reason IS NOT NULL.

On any runtime error (including the THROW for a NULL id): rolls back if a transaction is open, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<unknown>', userId = @hasherId), returns the envelope with Success 0.
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
